### Problem

The release candidate v7.19.0 fails the release scenario `bug-by-person-merges` in what the engine did: its `until` or `expect` did not hold, or could no longer hold, so the lane releases nothing and `v7` stays where it is.
Reproduced by: https://github.com/DiluxOne/.github/actions/runs/44602679962 scenario `bug-by-person-merges`.

The step that fails is the first, `until labels [awaiting-acceptance, needs-info]`; the lane saw "no label needs-info; saw labels awaiting-acceptance" (the lane's run https://github.com/DiluxOne/.github/actions/runs/44604468569). The cause is the scenarios' data, not a gate: `bug-by-person-merges` and `bug-not-reproduced` play at the same time and both open an issue from the body `bug-not-reproduced`, about the same file `scenarios/bug-not-reproduced/greeting.md`. The triage marked the first attempt's issue, DiluxOne/diluxone-test#2913, `duplicate` of #2907 (the other scenario's), so it never reproduced it and never added `needs-info`. G7 is a later step this scenario never reaches, so #879 does not touch it.

### Scope

- The cause of the failure above, in the engine, fixed with a test that would have caught it.

### Out of scope

- Changing the gates or what they check.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given v7.19.0's candidate with the fix, when the release lane plays `bug-by-person-merges` in the test repository, then it passes and the lane releases it.

### Criticality

Critical
